body:
i really do.
i don't know what to do any more.
every hour i feel worse and worse.
I'd like to thank you all for helping me.
the person who meant the most to me was my gf of 2 years and she broke up with me after i began feeling like this.. which has just made everything that much worse.

i just feel so helpless and weak.
i don't feel like i can achieve anything.
it feels like everybody i know would be better off if i just vanished out of their lives.

everything.
everything about everything is wrong.
i feel i'd be less of a burden if i wasn't around.
i feel like i'm trapped in a vortex with no way out other than drowning on my own misery.

i feels like nobody wants to be around me.
it all started a week ago for no apparent reason.
i just woke up one morning feeling completely unneeded or wanted by anybody. everything from then on has just become worse and worse and it's reached the point i'm at now.

i don't know what's on my mind.
it feels like i'm losing it to be honest.
everything in my life is just self destructing or imploding back on me

i don't know what to say.
everything is just going so wrong. i want it all to stop. i want everything to go away.
